analysis.title: Prime HFs Update - Oct 30th at noon EST
key_insights: Markets sold off broadly on Oct 30, 2026, led by Tech, with the NDX down more than 3%. Momentum and growth factors underperformed.
Global Fundamental L/S managers are down 1.2% at noon EST (-1.8 SD move), driven primarily by beta and Info Tech. They are down 3.6% MTD and up 9% YTD.
Asia-focused funds are down 1.2% (-1 SD), down 9.5% MTD and up 14% YTD.
TMT-focused funds are down 3.8% (-2.6 SD), down 12.6% MTD, which cuts YTD gains to +5.1%.
Global Systematic L/S managers are down 0.6% (-1.5 SD), with losses from Asia and Europe partly offset by gains in the US. Momentum, crowding and short-term signals were the main drags.
Global Systematic L/S managers are down 3.5% MTD and on track for the first negative month of the year. They are still up 16% YTD.
risk_factors: Tech-led selloff with the NDX down more than 3% and momentum and growth factors underperforming.
Hedge fund exposure to beta and Info Tech drove the Fundamental L/S losses.
Crowding and momentum factor drag in systematic strategies.
vol_and_positioning: Global Fundamental L/S managers are down 1.2% at noon EST on Oct 30 (-1.8 SD), driven by beta and Info Tech exposure.
TMT-focused funds are down 3.8% (-2.6 SD) on the day, the largest move among the groups listed, and down 12.6% MTD.
Asia-focused funds are down 9.5% MTD, the weakest month-to-date figure among the groups listed.
Systematic L/S managers lost on momentum, crowding and short-term signals. They are on track for their first negative month of the year.
